subject: Risk-based PO carveout for SMB vendors — evidence & authority
messages:
From: Sophie Chen <sophie@minimart.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-19T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot billing: request for temporary no-PO lane

Hi Karthik + Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to kick off the 3-month pilot with Minimart’s SMB storefront group. One operational hitch came up: our procurement system issues POs only for enterprise contracts. For the pilot (expected spend ~ $2,500/month), our finance team would prefer to invoice on net-30 without a PO to speed testing.

We understand Redwood’s PO policy; to make this safe for both sides we assembled a short evidence pack (attached) showing:
- Company legal & tax docs
- Proof of payment history via our payment processor
- Sample invoice template and SOW for the pilot
- Initial risk score export (see procurement-risk-score.csv)

Is there a pragmatic temporary carveout you’d be open to for vendors under $5k/month, with monthly reconciliation and a two-week notice for termination? If needed we can sign a limited SOW addendum or a short DocuSign that restricts scope to the pilot.

Next steps we’re hoping for:
1) Confirmation of what evidence you need from us (I attached the pack I think helps).
2) A short approval (either finance or procurement) to accept invoices without PO for the pilot period.

Attachment: minimart-evidence-pack.pdf (3 pages, stub)

Appreciate it — Sophie
Sophie Chen
Head of Partnerships, Minimart Labs

Thanks Sophie — and great meeting yesterday. Laura — looping you in as procurement lead.

Quick thoughts from our side: we can consider a risk-based carveout for small pilots, but we need to lock down the controls and the approval authority. At minimum I’ll need:
- The evidence pack (received)
- Confirmation of expected monthly spend threshold ($5k suggested)
- A commitment to monthly reconciliation and one-sentence termination right

Can you confirm whether Minimart can provide a signed pilot addendum (1 page) that:
- Limits liability to pilot scope,
- Commits to net-30 payment terms, and
- Allows Redwood to perform basic vendor checks?

Laura — is procurement comfortable with a conditional invoice-only path for pilots under $5k with sampling and a monthly review? If yes I’ll route for Marissa’s OK on the finance side (we should capture who signs off for the waiver).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Partnerships (Redwood Inference)

Hi all,

Reviewing the pack — thanks Sophie. Procurement position below (high level):

We can approve a conditional invoice-only lane for pilots that meet all of the following controls:
- Vendor verified (company registration + tax ID)
- Pilot SOW signed (we need the one-page addendum)
- Monthly reconciliations and sample invoice audit (we will sample 1 invoice per month)
- Spend cap of $5k/month set in our system; any breach auto-triggers PO requirement
- Data handling notes recorded (if vendor touches customer data we need an elevated checklist)

I attached our procurement checklist and fillable evidence matrix — please complete and return. Once the checklist is complete I recommend Marissa approve a delegated waiver for this single pilot for 90 days with a 30-day review cadence.

Attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx (stub)

Regards,

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: 2026-12-20T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot billing: request for temporary no-PO lane — conditional approval

Thanks Laura — reviewed the evidence pack and the draft addendum. I’m comfortable granting a conditional waiver for the SMB pilot under these terms:

1) Waiver scope: invoice-only (no PO) for a maximum of $5k/month for up to 90 days, scoped to the signed pilot addendum.
2) Controls: completed procurement checklist + monthly reconciliation uploaded to our shared drive by the 10th of each following month.
3) Audit & revocation: Procurement retains right to revoke waiver with 14 days notice if sampling finds material issues.
4) Finance ops: Minimart must include our Redwood customer code in every invoice. Payments will follow net-30.

Sophie — please:
- Send back the completed procurement-checklist.xlsx by EOD Thursday.
- Include the signed addendum and indicate the Redwood customer code to appear on invoices.

Once we have that, I will record a formal waiver in the system and notify AP to accept invoices without PO for the pilot scope. Welcome aboard and happy to accelerate this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
